custom_preconds:
A confirmed custom-role user exists whose role grants ONLY Schedule | View and Schedule | Create & Edit (no Work Orders view, Work Orders view-mode off, no other areas).
The user has a default workplace assigned (else /schedule redirects to /no-location).
At least one unscheduled work order exists in the org so the unscheduled-WO select has an option to render, and the day-resource calendar has a clickable resource-interval cell in the user's scope.

custom_steps_separated.content: Log in as the Schedule Create&Edit-only custom-role user and open /schedule
custom_steps_separated.expected: The day-resource calendar renders (date header visible), no redirect to /access-denied.

custom_steps_separated.content: Left-click an empty time-interval cell to open the schedule context menu
custom_steps_separated.expected: The context menu opens showing "Assign existing work order" (the create/assign affordances are visible because the role has Schedule Create & Edit).

The TimeSlotDialog opens and the unscheduled-work-order select fetches GET /api/work-orders/list-with-unscheduled-tasks and populates its options; the app stays on /schedule and does NOT redirect to /access-denied.

title: Schedule Create and Edit only role opens Assign existing work order dialog and unscheduled WO list loads
